dimensions.implementationPercent: Estimated completeness of the implemented subsystem and its live runtime wiring.
dimensions.automatedValidationPercent: Estimated coverage of relevant automated contracts/regressions. It is not the percentage of tests that passed on the current head.
dimensions.fieldEvidencePercent: Strength of independently verified results on realistic external tasks. Synthetic fixtures and internal unit tests do not count as field evidence.
dimensions.releaseReadinessPercent: Estimated completion of clean-machine install, runtime services, UI/voice, security, soak, licensing and reproducible archive requirements.

methodology.scoreScale: 0 = absent/unproven; 100 = evidenced against the lane's full stated release requirements.
